It's actually nothing new.
He played in the Air Max 1 mid, early in the 2015-16 season, then switched to the Air Max
90 runner for a couple of seasons now, and it all began when he suffered a broken fibula
and ankle damage outside of a Manhattan nightclub on April 8, 2015.

that.

pattern outsole, South Faloche says they have great grip.

Rookie Donovan Mitchell said, it's definitely swaggy though, but I don't know if I could
